Package com.eqixiac.equinix.core.client

package com.eqixiac.equinix.core.client
Core client infrastructure for the Equinix Java SDK. Contains the Config holder (a concrete class that domain *ConfigImpl configuration classes extend), and the EquinixClient transport client that the domain facades hold by composition — it manages HTTP communication, the OAuth token lifecycle, and the merged apiParams catalogue. The ClientBase provides request-building utilities, and ResourceClientBase adds CRUD + pagination helpers for internal client implementations.
